checks.name: ck_study_challenges_dates
checks.sqltext: (start_at IS NULL OR isfinite(start_at)) AND (deadline IS NULL OR isfinite(deadline)) AND (start_at IS NULL OR deadline IS NULL OR deadline >= start_at)

checks.name: ck_study_challenges_description
checks.sqltext: char_length(description) >= 1 AND char_length(description) <= 2000 AND description = btrim(description) AND description !~ '^[[:space:]]*$'::text

checks.name: ck_study_challenges_generation_criteria
checks.sqltext: jsonb_typeof(generation_criteria) = 'object'::text AND generation_criteria <> '{}'::jsonb AND octet_length(generation_criteria::text) <= 16384

checks.name: ck_study_challenges_resource_subject
checks.sqltext: subject_id IS NOT NULL OR activity_id IS NULL AND study_session_id IS NULL

checks.name: ck_study_challenges_source
checks.sqltext: source = ANY (ARRAY['ai'::text, 'manual'::text])

checks.name: ck_study_challenges_status
checks.sqltext: status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_progress'::text, 'completed'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])

checks.name: ck_study_challenges_target_type
checks.sqltext: target_type = ANY (ARRAY['study_minutes'::text, 'activity_completion'::text, 'session_completion'::text, 'subject_mastery'::text, 'custom'::text])

checks.name: ck_study_challenges_target_value
checks.sqltext:
CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(target_value) <> 'object'::text OR octet_length(target_value::text) < 2 OR octet_length(target_value::text) > 4096 THEN false
    WHEN target_type = 'study_minutes'::text THEN (subject_id IS NOT NULL OR study_session_id IS NOT NULL) AND target_value ? 'minutes'::text AND (target_value - 'minutes'::text) = '{}'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(target_value -> 'minutes'::text) = 'number'::text AND
    CASE
        WHEN (target_value ->> 'minutes'::text) ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$'::text THEN ((target_value ->> 'minutes'::text)::integer) >= 1 AND ((target_value ->> 'minutes'::text)::integer) <= 1440
        ELSE false
    END
    WHEN target_type = 'activity_completion'::text THEN activity_id IS NOT NULL AND target_value = '{"status": "completed"}'::jsonb
    WHEN target_type = 'session_completion'::text THEN study_session_id IS NOT NULL AND target_value = '{"lifecycle": "finished"}'::jsonb
    WHEN target_type = 'subject_mastery'::text THEN subject_id IS NOT NULL AND target_value ?& ARRAY['criterion'::text, 'threshold'::text] AND (target_value - 'criterion'::text - 'threshold'::text) = '{}'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(target_value -> 'criterion'::text) = 'string'::text AND char_length(btrim(target_value ->> 'criterion'::text)) >= 1 AND char_length(btrim(target_value ->> 'criterion'::text)) <= 200 AND
    CASE
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(target_value -> 'threshold'::text) = 'number'::text AND (target_value ->> 'threshold'::text) ~ '^(100|[1-9]?[0-9])$'::text THEN ((target_value ->> 'threshold'::text)::integer) >= 1 AND ((target_value ->> 'threshold'::text)::integer) <= 100
        ELSE false
    END
    WHEN target_type = 'custom'::text THEN target_value <> '{}'::jsonb
    ELSE false
END

checks.name: ck_study_challenges_timestamps
checks.sqltext: isfinite(created_at) AND isfinite(updated_at) AND updated_at >= created_at

checks.name: ck_study_challenges_title
checks.sqltext: char_length(title) >= 1 AND char_length(title) <= 100 AND title = btrim(title) AND title !~ '^[[:space:]]*$'::text

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((start_at IS NULL) OR isfinite(start_at)) AND ((deadline IS NULL) OR isfinite(deadline)) AND ((start_at IS NULL) OR (deadline IS NULL) OR (deadline >= start_at))))
CHECK (((subject_id IS NOT NULL) OR ((activity_id IS NULL) AND (study_session_id IS NULL))))

CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN ((jsonb_typeof(target_value) <> 'object'::text) OR ((octet_length((target_value)::text) < 2) OR (octet_length((target_value)::text) > 4096))) THEN false
    WHEN (target_type = 'study_minutes'::text) THEN (((subject_id IS NOT NULL) OR (study_session_id IS NOT NULL)) AND (target_value ? 'minutes'::text) AND ((target_value - 'minutes'::text) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((target_value -> 'minutes'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND
    CASE
        WHEN ((target_value ->> 'minutes'::text) ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$'::text) THEN ((((target_value ->> 'minutes'::text))::integer >= 1) AND (((target_value ->> 'minutes'::text))::integer <= 1440))
        ELSE false
    END)
    WHEN (target_type = 'activity_completion'::text) THEN ((activity_id IS NOT NULL) AND (target_value = '{"status": "completed"}'::jsonb))
    WHEN (target_type = 'session_completion'::text) THEN ((study_session_id IS NOT NULL) AND (target_value = '{"lifecycle": "finished"}'::jsonb))
    WHEN (target_type = 'subject_mastery'::text) THEN ((subject_id IS NOT NULL) AND (target_value ?& ARRAY['criterion'::text, 'threshold'::text]) AND (((target_value - 'criterion'::text) - 'threshold'::text) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((target_value -> 'criterion'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((char_length(btrim((target_value ->> 'criterion'::text))) >= 1) AND (char_length(btrim((target_value ->> 'criterion'::text))) <= 200)) AND
    CASE
        WHEN ((jsonb_typeof((target_value -> 'threshold'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND ((target_value ->> 'threshold'::text) ~ '^(100|[1-9]?[0-9])$'::text)) THEN ((((target_value ->> 'threshold'::text))::integer >= 1) AND (((target_value ->> 'threshold'::text))::integer <= 100))
        ELSE false
    END)
    WHEN (target_type = 'custom'::text) THEN (target_value <> '{}'::jsonb)
    ELSE false
END)
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, plan_id) REFERENCES study_plans(user_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, plan_id, subject_id, activity_id) REFERENCES study_plan_activities(user_id, plan_id, subject_id, activity_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, plan_id, subject_id, study_session_id) REFERENCES study_plan_sessions(user_id, plan_id, subject_id, study_session_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

FOREIGN KEY (user_id, subject_id, activity_id) REFERENCES activities(user_id, subject_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, plan_id, subject_id) REFERENCES study_plan_subjects(user_id, plan_id, subject_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (((field_path IS NULL) OR (((char_length(field_path) >= 1) AND (char_length(field_path) <= 200)) AND (field_path = btrim(field_path)) AND (field_path !~ '^[[:space:]]*$'::text))))
CHECK ((((proposed_value IS NULL) OR (octet_length((proposed_value)::text) <= 65536)) AND ((chosen_value IS NULL) OR (octet_length((chosen_value)::text) <= 65536))))

CHECK ((((action = 'accepted'::text) AND (proposed_value IS NOT NULL) AND (chosen_value IS NOT NULL)) OR ((action = 'edited'::text) AND (field_path IS NOT NULL) AND (proposed_value IS NOT NULL) AND (chosen_value IS NOT NULL) AND (proposed_value IS DISTINCT FROM chosen_value)) OR ((action = ANY (ARRAY['rejected'::text, 'regenerated'::text])) AND (proposed_value IS NOT NULL) AND (chosen_value IS NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, plan_id) REFERENCES study_plans(user_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, subject_id, study_session_id) REFERENCES study_sessions(user_id, subject_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, plan_id, subject_id) REFERENCES study_plan_subjects(user_id, plan_id, subject_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, subject_id) REFERENCES subjects(user_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id, plan_id) REFERENCES study_plans(user_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
